title: 潛盾機刀具磨耗管理
summary: 本課聚焦以刀具軌跡、接觸荷重與磨耗證據解釋掘進刀具壽命。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
summaryEn: This course focuses on explain cutter life using trajectories, contact loads and wear evidence. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「刀具半徑與行程」與「貫入與每轉進尺」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cutter radius and travel" and "Penetration per revolution": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 刀具半徑與行程：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cutter radius and travel: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「刀具半徑與行程」如何影響潛盾機刀具磨耗管理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cutter radius and travel” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “TBM cutter-wear management”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 不同半徑刀具每轉走過不同距離，外緣刀即使承受相同轉數也有較長接觸路徑。磨耗比較須規一化里程或體積並保留刀位，不能用更換次數直接推斷材料品質。 假設刀位半徑5 m、轉速4 rpm，切向速度v=2πrn/60=2.094 m/s；不代表建議轉速。 把外緣刀較快磨耗全歸於材料缺陷會錯判供應品質，刀位更換後仍沿用舊行程又會污染趨勢；壽命模型因此對下一段地層失去可比性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「刀具半徑與行程」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tools at different radii travel different distances per revolution. Outer cutters therefore accumulate longer contact paths at equal revolutions, requiring wear normalization by travel or excavation and retention of cutter position rather than replacement count alone. Assume cutter radius 5 m and rotation 4 rpm; tangential speed v=2πrn/60=2.094 m/s, not a recommended speed. Attributing faster outer wear solely to material defects misjudges quality, while retaining old travel after relocation corrupts trends. The resulting life model loses comparability for the next geological reach. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cutter radius and travel” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有刀位轉數相同時，接觸行程和磨耗需求也完全相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal revolutions give identical contact travel and wear demand at every cutter position." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「刀具半徑與行程」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Cutter radius and travel”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 刀具半徑與行程
knowledge.text: 不同半徑刀具每轉走過不同距離，外緣刀即使承受相同轉數也有較長接觸路徑。磨耗比較須規一化里程或體積並保留刀位，不能用更換次數直接推斷材料品質。
knowledge.textEn: Tools at different radii travel different distances per revolution. Outer cutters therefore accumulate longer contact paths at equal revolutions, requiring wear normalization by travel or excavation and retention of cutter position rather than replacement count alone.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：所有刀位轉數相同時，接觸行程和磨耗需求也完全相同。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal revolutions give identical contact travel and wear demand at every cutter position. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「潛盾機刀具磨耗管理」的「刀具半徑與行程：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出地層、地下水、開挖邊界與支撐的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「隧道模型掘進交班」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與地質假設、監測位置、時間順序及基準點版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Cutter radius and travel: mechanism and system paths” in “TBM cutter-wear management”. Draw the ground, groundwater, excavation boundary and support interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Tunnel model drive handover” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ground assumptions, monitoring locations, time order and benchmark version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「刀具半徑與行程」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cutter radius and travel" is correct?
options: 所有刀位轉數相同時，接觸行程和磨耗需求也完全相同。
不同半徑刀具每轉走過不同距離，外緣刀即使承受相同轉數也有較長接觸路徑。
每轉進尺越大就必定代表切削效率和刀具壽命越好。
optionsEn: Equal revolutions give identical contact travel and wear demand at every cutter position.
Tools at different radii travel different distances per revolution.
Greater penetration per revolution necessarily improves cutting efficiency and cutter life.
quiz.explanation: 不同半徑刀具每轉走過不同距離，外緣刀即使承受相同轉數也有較長接觸路徑。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Tools at different radii travel different distances per revolution. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 刀具半徑與行程：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cutter radius and travel: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「刀具半徑與行程」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cutter radius and travel” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設刀位半徑5 m、轉速4 rpm，切向速度v=2πrn/60=2.094 m/s；不代表建議轉速。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume cutter radius 5 m and rotation 4 rpm; tangential speed v=2πrn/60=2.094 m/s, not a recommended speed. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以刀位圖、轉數及地層日誌計算接觸行程，對照同類刀具的量測磨耗；將外緣與中心刀分組比較，無法追溯位置的磨耗資料不得直接用於壽命排名。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Combine cutter map, revolutions and geology to calculate travel and compare measured wear for like tools; group outer and center positions separately and do not rank life from records lacking position traceability.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設刀位半徑5 m、轉速4 rpm，切向速度v=2πrn/60=2.094 m/s；不代表建議轉速。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume cutter radius 5 m and rotation 4 rpm; tangential speed v=2πrn/60=2.094 m/s, not a recommended speed.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「刀具半徑與行程」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cutter radius and travel", which statement holds?
options: 旋轉比能增加只能由岩石變硬造成，與排碴無關。
刀環剩餘直徑足夠就證明軸承和轉動狀態也正常。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: Higher rotational specific energy can only come from harder rock, never muck removal.
Adequate remaining ring diameter proves that bearings and rotation are also healthy.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 刀具半徑與行程：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cutter radius and travel: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「刀具半徑與行程」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cutter radius and travel” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以刀位圖、轉數及地層日誌計算接觸行程，對照同類刀具的量測磨耗；將外緣與中心刀分組比較，無法追溯位置的磨耗資料不得直接用於壽命排名。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把外緣刀較快磨耗全歸於材料缺陷會錯判供應品質，刀位更換後仍沿用舊行程又會污染趨勢；壽命模型因此對下一段地層失去可比性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Combine cutter map, revolutions and geology to calculate travel and compare measured wear for like tools; group outer and center positions separately and do not rank life from records lacking position traceability. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Attributing faster outer wear solely to material defects misjudges quality, while retaining old travel after relocation corrupts trends. The resulting life model loses comparability for the next geological reach. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄刀具半徑與行程的資料來源與適用條件。以刀位圖、轉數及地層日誌計算接觸行程，對照同類刀具的量測磨耗；將外緣與中心刀分組比較，無法追溯位置的磨耗資料不得直接用於壽命排名。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for cutter radius and travel. Combine cutter map, revolutions and geology to calculate travel and compare measured wear for like tools; group outer and center positions separately and do not rank life from records lacking position traceability.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把外緣刀較快磨耗全歸於材料缺陷會錯判供應品質，刀位更換後仍沿用舊行程又會污染趨勢；壽命模型因此對下一段地層失去可比性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Attributing faster outer wear solely to material defects misjudges quality, while retaining old travel after relocation corrupts trends. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以刀位圖、轉數及地層日誌計算接觸行程，對照同類刀具的量測磨耗；將外緣與中心刀分組比較，無法追溯位置的磨耗資料不得直接用於壽命排名。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把外緣刀較快磨耗全歸於材料缺陷會錯判供應品質，刀位更換後仍沿用舊行程又會污染趨勢；壽命模型因此對下一段地層失去可比性。
knowledge.textEn: Combine cutter map, revolutions and geology to calculate travel and compare measured wear for like tools; group outer and center positions separately and do not rank life from records lacking position traceability. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Attributing faster outer wear solely to material defects misjudges quality, while retaining old travel after relocation corrupts trends. The resulting life model loses comparability for the next geological reach.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄刀具半徑與行程的資料來源與適用條件。以刀位圖、轉數及地層日誌計算接觸行程，對照同類刀具的量測磨耗；將外緣與中心刀分組比較，無法追溯位置的磨耗資料不得直接用於壽命排名。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for cutter radius and travel. Combine cutter map, revolutions and geology to calculate travel and compare measured wear for like tools; group outer and center positions separately and do not rank life from records lacking position traceability.

quiz.question: 要驗證「刀具半徑與行程」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cutter radius and travel"?
options: 以刀位圖、轉數及地層日誌計算接觸行程，對照同類刀具的量測磨耗；將外緣與中心刀分組比較，無法追溯位置的磨耗資料不得直接用於壽命排名。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
相同刀間距貫入比在所有岩性都會有同樣最佳切削效果。
optionsEn: Combine cutter map, revolutions and geology to calculate travel and compare measured wear for like tools.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The same spacing-penetration ratio gives identical optimum cutting in every rock type.
quiz.explanation: 以刀位圖、轉數及地層日誌計算接觸行程，對照同類刀具的量測磨耗；將外緣與中心刀分組比較，無法追溯位置的磨耗資料不得直接用於壽命排名。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Combine cutter map, revolutions and geology to calculate travel and compare measured wear for like tools; group outer and center positions separately and do not rank life from records lacking position traceability. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 刀具半徑與行程：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cutter radius and travel: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「刀具半徑與行程」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cutter radius and travel” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把外緣刀較快磨耗全歸於材料缺陷會錯判供應品質，刀位更換後仍沿用舊行程又會污染趨勢；壽命模型因此對下一段地層失去可比性。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Attributing faster outer wear solely to material defects misjudges quality, while retaining old travel after relocation corrupts trends. The resulting life model loses comparability for the next geological reach. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把外緣刀較快磨耗全歸於材料缺陷會錯判供應品質，刀位更換後仍沿用舊行程又會污染趨勢；壽命模型因此對下一段地層失去可比性。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The resulting life model loses comparability for the next geological reach.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有刀位轉數相同時，接觸行程和磨耗需求也完全相同。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal revolutions give identical contact travel and wear demand at every cutter position." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把外緣刀較快磨耗全歸於材料缺陷會錯判供應品質，刀位更換後仍沿用舊行程又會污染趨勢；壽命模型因此對下一段地層失去可比性。
knowledge.textEn: Attributing faster outer wear solely to material defects misjudges quality, while retaining old travel after relocation corrupts trends. The resulting life model loses comparability for the next geological reach.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「刀具半徑與行程」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cutter radius and travel" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把外緣刀較快磨耗全歸於材料缺陷會錯判供應品質，刀位更換後仍沿用舊行程又會污染趨勢；壽命模型因此對下一段地層失去可比性。
每轉進尺越大就必定代表切削效率和刀具壽命越好。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Attributing faster outer wear solely to material defects misjudges quality, while retaining old travel after relocation corrupts trends.
Greater penetration per revolution necessarily improves cutting efficiency and cutter life.
quiz.explanation: 把外緣刀較快磨耗全歸於材料缺陷會錯判供應品質，刀位更換後仍沿用舊行程又會污染趨勢；壽命模型因此對下一段地層失去可比性。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Attributing faster outer wear solely to material defects misjudges quality, while retaining old travel after relocation corrupts trends. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 貫入與每轉進尺：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Penetration per revolution: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「貫入與每轉進尺」如何影響潛盾機刀具磨耗管理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Penetration per revolution” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “TBM cutter-wear management”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每轉進尺把推進速率與轉速連結，反映刀具每次通過的切入尺度，但它也受岩體裂隙與刀具間距影響。高進尺未必代表高效率，過大載重可能使刀環或軸承提早失效。 假設推進30 mm/min、轉速3 rpm，每轉進尺p=10 mm/rev；未提供刀具容許荷重。 轉速讀值或里程時間不一致會製造假高進尺，軟弱帶自然崩解也可能看似切削優秀；若據此增加荷重，進入硬岩後可能超出刀具能力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「貫入與每轉進尺」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Penetration per revolution links advance and rotation to cutting scale, but also depends on fractures and spacing. High penetration is not automatically efficient if excessive load damages cutter rings or bearings prematurely. Assume advance 30 mm/min and rotation 3 rpm; penetration p=10 mm/rev, without specifying allowable cutter load. Unsynchronized speed and distance create false high penetration, while weak-ground disintegration can mimic excellent cutting. Increasing load on that evidence may exceed tool capability when harder ground returns. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Penetration per revolution” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每轉進尺越大就必定代表切削效率和刀具壽命越好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Greater penetration per revolution necessarily improves cutting efficiency and cutter life." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「貫入與每轉進尺」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Penetration per revolution”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 貫入與每轉進尺
knowledge.text: 每轉進尺把推進速率與轉速連結，反映刀具每次通過的切入尺度，但它也受岩體裂隙與刀具間距影響。高進尺未必代表高效率，過大載重可能使刀環或軸承提早失效。
knowledge.textEn: Penetration per revolution links advance and rotation to cutting scale, but also depends on fractures and spacing. High penetration is not automatically efficient if excessive load damages cutter rings or bearings prematurely.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每轉進尺越大就必定代表切削效率和刀具壽命越好。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Greater penetration per revolution necessarily improves cutting efficiency and cutter life. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「貫入與每轉進尺」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Penetration per revolution" is correct?
options: 每轉進尺越大就必定代表切削效率和刀具壽命越好。
總推力除刀具數就能得到每顆刀實際承受的峰值荷重。
每轉進尺把推進速率與轉速連結，反映刀具每次通過的切入尺度，但它也受岩體裂隙與刀具間距影響。
optionsEn: Greater penetration per revolution necessarily improves cutting efficiency and cutter life.
Total thrust divided by cutter count gives each cutter's actual peak load.
Penetration per revolution links advance and rotation to cutting scale, but also depends on fractures and spacing.
quiz.explanation: 每轉進尺把推進速率與轉速連結，反映刀具每次通過的切入尺度，但它也受岩體裂隙與刀具間距影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Penetration per revolution links advance and rotation to cutting scale, but also depends on fractures and spacing. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 貫入與每轉進尺：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Penetration per revolution: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「貫入與每轉進尺」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Penetration per revolution” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設推進30 mm/min、轉速3 rpm，每轉進尺p=10 mm/rev；未提供刀具容許荷重。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume advance 30 mm/min and rotation 3 rpm; penetration p=10 mm/rev, without specifying allowable cutter load. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步推進、轉速、推力與扭矩，將相同地層與刀具狀態下的區段比較；刀具工程師需核對載重範圍與振動，不能只以提高每轉進尺作績效目標。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize advance, rotation, thrust and torque and compare intervals with similar geology and tool condition; cutter engineers check loads and vibration instead of treating greater penetration per revolution as the sole performance objective.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設推進30 mm/min、轉速3 rpm，每轉進尺p=10 mm/rev；未提供刀具容許荷重。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume advance 30 mm/min and rotation 3 rpm; penetration p=10 mm/rev, without specifying allowable cutter load.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「貫入與每轉進尺」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Penetration per revolution", which statement holds?
options: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
前一岩層的平均磨耗率可以無條件預測下一岩層壽命。
班平均扭矩正常就表示沒有局部刀具衝擊疲勞。
optionsEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
The previous stratum's mean wear rate predicts life in the next stratum unconditionally.
Normal shift-average torque means no localized cutter impact fatigue is occurring.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 貫入與每轉進尺：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Penetration per revolution: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「貫入與每轉進尺」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Penetration per revolution” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步推進、轉速、推力與扭矩，將相同地層與刀具狀態下的區段比較；刀具工程師需核對載重範圍與振動，不能只以提高每轉進尺作績效目標。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：轉速讀值或里程時間不一致會製造假高進尺，軟弱帶自然崩解也可能看似切削優秀；若據此增加荷重，進入硬岩後可能超出刀具能力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize advance, rotation, thrust and torque and compare intervals with similar geology and tool condition; cutter engineers check loads and vibration instead of treating greater penetration per revolution as the sole performance objective. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Unsynchronized speed and distance create false high penetration, while weak-ground disintegration can mimic excellent cutting. Increasing load on that evidence may exceed tool capability when harder ground returns. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄貫入與每轉進尺的資料來源與適用條件。同步推進、轉速、推力與扭矩，將相同地層與刀具狀態下的區段比較；刀具工程師需核對載重範圍與振動，不能只以提高每轉進尺作績效目標。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for penetration per revolution. Synchronize advance, rotation, thrust and torque and compare intervals with similar geology and tool condition; cutter engineers check loads and vibration instead of treating greater penetration per revolution as the sole performance objective.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：轉速讀值或里程時間不一致會製造假高進尺，軟弱帶自然崩解也可能看似切削優秀；若據此增加荷重，進入硬岩後可能超出刀具能力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unsynchronized speed and distance create false high penetration, while weak-ground disintegration can mimic excellent cutting. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步推進、轉速、推力與扭矩，將相同地層與刀具狀態下的區段比較；刀具工程師需核對載重範圍與振動，不能只以提高每轉進尺作績效目標。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：轉速讀值或里程時間不一致會製造假高進尺，軟弱帶自然崩解也可能看似切削優秀；若據此增加荷重，進入硬岩後可能超出刀具能力。
knowledge.textEn: Synchronize advance, rotation, thrust and torque and compare intervals with similar geology and tool condition; cutter engineers check loads and vibration instead of treating greater penetration per revolution as the sole performance objective. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Unsynchronized speed and distance create false high penetration, while weak-ground disintegration can mimic excellent cutting. Increasing load on that evidence may exceed tool capability when harder ground returns.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄貫入與每轉進尺的資料來源與適用條件。同步推進、轉速、推力與扭矩，將相同地層與刀具狀態下的區段比較；刀具工程師需核對載重範圍與振動，不能只以提高每轉進尺作績效目標。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for penetration per revolution. Synchronize advance, rotation, thrust and torque and compare intervals with similar geology and tool condition; cutter engineers check loads and vibration instead of treating greater penetration per revolution as the sole performance objective.

quiz.question: 要驗證「貫入與每轉進尺」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Penetration per revolution"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
同步推進、轉速、推力與扭矩，將相同地層與刀具狀態下的區段比較；刀具工程師需核對載重範圍與振動，不能只以提高每轉進尺作績效目標。
只更換刀環就可以把未更換軸承的累積使用時間歸零。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Synchronize advance, rotation, thrust and torque and compare intervals with similar geology and tool condition.
Replacing only the ring resets accumulated service time of the unchanged bearing.
quiz.explanation: 同步推進、轉速、推力與扭矩，將相同地層與刀具狀態下的區段比較；刀具工程師需核對載重範圍與振動，不能只以提高每轉進尺作績效目標。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronize advance, rotation, thrust and torque and compare intervals with similar geology and tool condition; cutter engineers check loads and vibration instead of treating greater penetration per revolution as the sole performance objective. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 貫入與每轉進尺：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Penetration per revolution: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「貫入與每轉進尺」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Penetration per revolution” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 轉速讀值或里程時間不一致會製造假高進尺，軟弱帶自然崩解也可能看似切削優秀；若據此增加荷重，進入硬岩後可能超出刀具能力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unsynchronized speed and distance create false high penetration, while weak-ground disintegration can mimic excellent cutting. Increasing load on that evidence may exceed tool capability when harder ground returns. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：轉速讀值或里程時間不一致會製造假高進尺，軟弱帶自然崩解也可能看似切削優秀；若據此增加荷重，進入硬岩後可能超出刀具能力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Increasing load on that evidence may exceed tool capability when harder ground returns.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每轉進尺越大就必定代表切削效率和刀具壽命越好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Greater penetration per revolution necessarily improves cutting efficiency and cutter life." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 轉速讀值或里程時間不一致會製造假高進尺，軟弱帶自然崩解也可能看似切削優秀；若據此增加荷重，進入硬岩後可能超出刀具能力。
knowledge.textEn: Unsynchronized speed and distance create false high penetration, while weak-ground disintegration can mimic excellent cutting. Increasing load on that evidence may exceed tool capability when harder ground returns.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「貫入與每轉進尺」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Penetration per revolution" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
總推力除刀具數就能得到每顆刀實際承受的峰值荷重。
轉速讀值或里程時間不一致會製造假高進尺，軟弱帶自然崩解也可能看似切削優秀；若據此增加荷重，進入硬岩後可能超出刀具能力。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Total thrust divided by cutter count gives each cutter's actual peak load.
Unsynchronized speed and distance create false high penetration, while weak-ground disintegration can mimic excellent cutting.
quiz.explanation: 轉速讀值或里程時間不一致會製造假高進尺，軟弱帶自然崩解也可能看似切削優秀；若據此增加荷重，進入硬岩後可能超出刀具能力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unsynchronized speed and distance create false high penetration, while weak-ground disintegration can mimic excellent cutting. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
